records.title: Fast Spatial Memory with Elastic Test-Time Training
records.reason: Spatial test-time memory is for 3D reconstruction; despite an inference-time memory mechanism, the target is not LLM/VLM inference and no direct lineage connection is established.

records.title: A 3 nm FinFET 125 TOPS/W-29 TFLOPS/W, 90 TOPS/mm2-17 TFLOPS/mm2 SRAM-Based INT8, and FP16 Digital-CIM Compiler With Support for Multi-Weight Update/Cycle
records.reason: The SRAM digital-CIM article is directly about efficient INT8/FP16 AI inference hardware, but primary full text was not retrieved, so LLM applicability cannot be assessed.

records.title: BidDeepSC-1.58b: 1.58-Bit Bidirectional Slimmable Semantic Communication System
records.reason: Bidirectional semantic communication compression is not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Multi-Layered Memory Architectures for LLM Agents: An Experimental Evaluation of Long-Term Context Retention
records.reason: The paper studies agent memory retention and bounded context, but its central contribution is memory architecture/quality rather than a concrete LLM inference optimization, and the abstract’s claims need cautious treatment.

records.title: Video-Oasis: Rethinking Evaluation of Video Understanding
records.reason: This is an evaluation critique/benchmarking study of video understanding rather than an inference improvement; retain only as a weak evaluation-lineage candidate.
